_meta.split: leakage-controlled global 10% PubChem held-out (union-find clusters + single seed-0 shuffle)
_meta.note: Retraining on the corrected (v2) dataset — diastereotopic protons get independent shifts. All tiers in progress; held-out metrics are pending and repopulate as v2 checkpoints land. Split: near-duplicates grouped by union-find (matrix fingerprint + InChIKey), the clusters placed by a single random shuffle (numpy default_rng seed 0), last ~10% of molecules (whole clusters) held out; every model scored on identical molecules.
